sources.role: parallel FastPrep page with identical statement, placeholder constraints and example

oa-flexport-3.rangeDisclosure: Both sources state the constraints only as a placeholder ("An unknown myth for now"), so the original length has no upper bound. The length is set to the transport limit: 1<=|num|<=3*10^7 (about 30MB per maximal input within the 32MiB per-case budget); the alphabet stays digits 0-9 with any leading digit. Leading zeros inside a segment are evaluated as ordinary decimal integers (implied by "the value of the expression is then evaluated"; no source text forbids them).
corrections: None to the original example 123 -> 168. Second and third public examples are authored.
